title: Throughput and tail-latency telemetry for endpoints, model variants, and regions
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Provide per-endpoint, per-model-variant, and per-region telemetry for throughput (tokens/sec) and tail latency (p95/p99) with regression detection and dashboarding. This ticket scopes the end-to-end pipeline: instrumentation, ingestion, rollup strategy, dashboard surface, and alerting. Motivation: customers and platform teams need deterministic signals to catch regressions that only appear at the tail or under specific regional traffic patterns. Current gaps: aggregated latency rollups exist at service-level but do not correlate with model variant and region; throughput is measured coarsely; no automatic tail-regression detector that ties back to recent deploys or model switches.
acceptance_criteria: Telemetry: tokens/sec and p95/p99 latency emitted from inference runtime with route, model_variant, region, and request_size tags
Ingestion: streaming collector writes metrics to metrics-store (Prometheus for short-term, ClickHouse for rollups) with 1s granularity
Dashboards: new dashboard tab in Console showing heatmap and time-series for tokens/sec, p95, p99 by endpoint/model_variant/region with quick filters
Regression Detection: automated job that computes week-over-week and deploy-relative regressions for p95/p99 and fires alerts when increase > 15% and absolute p99 > 500ms
Traceability: UI shows the last N requests sampled for tail events with a link to the raw request ID / span
Tests: load-harness synthetic test that can exercise 10k tokens/sec to validate tokens/sec telemetry and synthetic tail injection for alert validation
implementation_notes: Instrumentation: add metrics from serving runtime: tokens_emitted_total (counter), request_latency_ms (histogram with custom buckets up to 10s), request_token_count (gauge). Attach labels: endpoint, model_variant, region, cpu_class, batch_size.

Rollups: Prometheus for immediate SLO dashboards (1s-1m), ClickHouse for weekly/monthly percentile rollups. Use t-digest aggregation for efficient p95/p99 in ClickHouse (store sketch blobs per 1m window per dimension).
Tag cardinality: To avoid explosion, restrict model_variant to top 50 active variants for rollups; others map to 'other'. Endpoint aliasing required to collapse staging/dev routes.
Collector changes: extend internal telemetry gateway to accept new metric families and thrift schema version bump (PR: github.com/redwood-inference/telemetry/pull/312).

Dashboards: Grafana panels to be embedded in Console. Panels: tokens/sec heatmap (region x model_variant), tail-latency small-multiples (endpoints), deploy-correlated regression view. Mockup: drive.google.com/drive/folders/1LatencyDashMock

Regression job: batch worker in infra that computes percent change over sliding baselines (1h, 24h, 7d). Alerting rules live in Alertmanager and send to #infra-slo and PagerDuty when customer_impact==high.

Synthetic load harness: extend existing load harness (repo: github.com/redwood-inference/load-harness) with a new scenario 'tail-inject' that adds random sleep jitter to 0.5% of requests to simulate tail amplification and validate detection rules.
Privacy: ensure sampled request payloads are redacted before storing. Follow data retention policy in docs/conpliance/telemetry-redaction.md.
Rollout: feature-flag telemetry_v2.2 -> gradual rollout: 5% -> 25% -> 100% across regions. Monitor cardinality and cardinality alarms during ramp.
Metrics QA: create k6/gatling scenario to validate tokens/sec counters do not double-count during retries; correlate with server logs (request_id) in Splunk query: index=inference request_id=*
